changes: Fixed Omi quitting by itself during first-run permission setup
Fixed the Save button turning blank in the Add Memory dialog as soon as you typed
Automatically deletes leftover agent tool-output files older than a week so they stop filling the Mac
Made each hourly macOS update start its Codemagic release build without waiting for GitHub's macOS queue
Fixed the screenshot embedding backfill failing to find the entries it needed to re-index
Notifications now come in exactly four types — Focus, Task, Insight, Memory — each controlled by its own toggle in Settings (the toggle formerly called Live Suggestions is now Focus Notifications)
Fixed macOS updates getting stuck before release when new changes kept landing during the hourly release train
Fixed the conversation processing banner overlapping source and duration details
Fixed longer push-to-talk questions losing the screenshot Omi answers from, so it can still see your screen
